name: Shinjin Soap Jou Poplar-chan ~Mezase! Maguwaria No.1~
original_name: 新人ソープ嬢ポプラちゃん～目指せ！マグワリアNo.1～
source:
One thing led to another and now the family restaurant of W*RKING!! is converted into a soapland.
Yuji's latest hire is ambitious buxom lolita Popura-chan.

Popura is bound to be awkward with her first client, but she wants to do good...
Her first client is Yuji! Of course it would be. It's destiny.
After she finishes pleasing him, she makes an plucky declaration.

"I'm going to be Wagn*ria's #1 soap queen!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ121946.html]DLsite English[/url]]
